title: KYA-OS interop registry entry
description: One standards-rail listing in the KYA-OS interop registry. Each entry lives at registry/interop/<slug>.json and the filename must equal the `slug` property. Entries state, with evidence, how KYA-OS relates to an external standard. Structural validation is enforced by scripts/validate.mjs; keep that script and this schema in sync. Honesty rule: `shipping` and `specified` require an evidence URL; a status is never listed above what the evidence shows.

standard.description: Display name of the external standard or protocol surface.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the entry filename: registry/interop/<slug>.json. Unique across the whole registry (builders AND interop). Builder entries reference these slugs in their `standards` array.

category.description: Which standards rail this entry belongs to; drives grouping on the site.

relationship.description: One-line statement of how KYA-OS relates to the standard (200 characters max). Details and caveats go in `notes`.

status.description: Integration maturity. shipping = code at the current release; specified = normative spec text without shipped code; planned = on the roadmap; exploring = under evaluation; none = explicitly no current relationship (listed so nobody has to guess). When maturity is mixed, list the conservative tier and explain in `notes`.

evidence.description: URL of the code or spec text that proves the status. Required when status is shipping or specified.

notes.description: Caveats, spec anchors, and provenance detail.

listedAt.description: Date the entry was added, YYYY-MM-DD.
